items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And then we played Sophisticated Lady in Berlin... Jaco wanted to come to Brussels... I wanna see you to… I wanna… you gotta come and do your thing on the one track to Brussels

ctx.x: ’79. And I was representing Belgium in the festival with the three musicians from, all of them Belgian. And at the press conference, somebody asked Jaco: “Mr. Pastorius, you see the menus of… and the menu of everybody who plays at this thing. But if you was to do a duo with somebody, who would you… would be your idea?” “Get me Toots.” That’s true. He said that. “Get me Toots.” Somebody told me that. “Get me Toots.” That’s what happened. And then we played Sophisticated Lady in Berlin. That was not [inaudible].…
